scope: Installed public active fixture and dispatch: exact source loading, one full extend call per positive case, complete output comparison, cache variants and the cheap semantic rejection.

checks.finding: Reference paths are caller arguments. Expected schema/iteration/child count and file presence are checked before proving. Reference data is used only in assertions/comparisons; package, state, running/fresh source matrices and message come from the original source directory.

Typed arrays require exactly four state/message words. Canonical Goldilocks bounds are checked. Iteration is exactly2 and the request state must match envelope.json. The existing source loader checks original package/public/frame/parent and complete witness projection shapes before any mutation.

original leaves the source unchanged. parent-absent removes only the derived parent cache. parent-changed alters that cache commitment/public/point/K/A/frame fields. Both variants change child frame metadata and redundant fresh w only; original running semantic fields, fresh claim, complete source Z matrices, state and message remain fixed.

Each positive case calls package.extend exactly once. Expected data, saved C proofs, D openings, result flags or replacement callbacks do not enter the call. The normal Active branch performs prior-state checking, cache reconstruction, canonical-family checking, full prove, step_inputs and complete_step.

Compares full returned Stage1State, all ordered CeClaim fields, complete parent cache and16 witnesses. Matrix comparison checks shape and all packed signed-unit masks, virtual-constant value or every Mat coordinate; tails are included.

Explicit c, x, m_in and adv assertions cover all four fields of the actual CcsClaim struct. This correctly replaces the unavailable whole-claim PartialEq. The complete fresh Mat, zero completion tail and empty redundant w are also checked.

The negative case loads original sources, changes child0.X[(0,0)] to2, recomputes the selected-context state hash/fresh public claim and calls the same public extend. It requires PriorFamily(PiDec(ChildXLowNorm)), not a generic failure. Production checks this family before prove; unchanged witness matrices make no successful-extension claim.

The positive dispatch forwards case/package/source/reference-envelope/reference-children in the declared order to owned_nifs::active. The negative dispatch forwards only package/source to that same fixture owner. stage1_nifs.rs imports active with the correct relative path; no Cargo target, production API, feature or ENV is added by these entries.

The sum is not a formal upper bound or evidence that a positive public run passed. This review does not authorize or launch a longer call.

limits: Each cache case needs its own positive execution result; one passing case cannot stand for all cases.
Terminal verification is separate: the full compared iteration3 envelope must have its own actual terminal checks. A saved success flag is not consumed.
This fixture compares full returned envelope data; it does not expose or compare internal public-extend NIFS proof bytes directly. Existing staged C/R/D proof-byte evidence remains separate.
The earlier compile failure on absent CcsClaim PartialEq remains a failed build; the explicit four-field repair is the reviewed current source.
